我如何喜欢我的雨 (Chinese (Simplified)) 世界已经陷入停滞，水在讲述着许多故事。 您何不打开这本书，听听那宛如歌声的雨声？ This is a Level 3 book for children who are ready to read on their own. Pratham Books goes digital to weave a whole new chapter in the realm of multilingual children's stories. Knitting together children, authors, illustrators and publishers. Folding in teachers, and translators. To create a rich fabric of openly licensed multilingual stories for the children of India and the world. Our unique online platform, StoryWeaver, is a playground where children, parents, teachers and librarians can get creative. Come, start weaving today, and help us get a book in every child's hand!

pages.originalText:
这时候就是我喜欢雨的时候当世界停下脚步



当水执着地讲述它的故事并且让你很难插话
pages.text:
我喜欢这样的雨——
世界停下脚步，
雨水不停地讲述自己的故事，
让你难以插话。

image.attributionText: Page 2: People running under a shelter in the rain , by Garima Gupta © Pratham Books, 2019. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 当像银串般的雨丝飘下来微微刺痛我的皮肤
pages.text:
银线般的雨丝飘下来，
轻轻碰着我的皮肤。

image.attributionText: Page 3: Woman and child enjoying a rainshower , by Garima Gupta © Pratham Books, 2019. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 当青蛙一整天呱呱乱叫无视夜晚到来
pages.text:
青蛙呱呱叫了一整天，
连夜晚来了也不停歇。

image.attributionText: Page 4: Frogs jumping from big leaves , by Garima Gupta © Pratham Books, 2019. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
当芋头无处不在百合花无处不见



当水畅流并亲吻种子土地属于千足虫
pages.text:
芋头长得到处都是，
百合花处处可见。
水流轻吻着种子，
千足虫在土地上游逛。

image.attributionText: Page 5: Woman and child sitting on a rock in the rain , by Garima Gupta © Pratham Books, 2019. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 当真菌统治大地和霉菌大胆露面稻谷长高，谷物满载
pages.text:
真菌热闹地冒出来，
霉菌也大胆露面。
稻谷长高，
谷穗变得沉甸甸。

image.attributionText: Page 6: Field of yam , by Garima Gupta © Pratham Books, 2019. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 这时候就是我喜欢雨的时候

Page 8: Three frogs jumping , by Garima Gupta © Pratham Books, 2019. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

editorialReview.visualReview: 已逐本检查原版全页插画联系图：画风连贯、图文对应、无不适合5岁目标的强惊吓近景；原JPG保持不变，仅显示裁掉外围空白。

dimensions.literacy: 短诗由常见雨、水、草木延伸至种子、真菌、千足虫，句子可拆成节奏段；词汇丰富而篇幅短。
dimensions.story: 不是情节型故事，而是有观察视角和感官趣味的自然诗，补足书库文体。
dimensions.visualProxy: 需要root确认雨景、植物、昆虫原图细节精良；若插画清晰，适合作为精选诗歌而非重复低阶故事。
